standard-dialogue.npc: Urgh, it just happened again! Every time I almost have it my hand slips.

standard-dialogue.player: Oh, that's unfortunate. Are you using a lockpick?

standard-dialogue.npc: Yes. Well actually, I'm using a Strange old lockpick. I found it while looting one of these coffins and I typically have better luck with it.

standard-dialogue.player: Oh, that's interesting. I'll keep my eyes out for one.

standard-dialogue.npc: I've found a few of them while raiding this place. There appear to be more of them on this floor than the floors above.

standard-dialogue.player: I see. If you don't mind me asking, you already have dark graceful so why are you still looking for hallowed marks?

standard-dialogue.npc: Oh, it's because of this little fellow following me. I've heard that the Dark acorn sold by the guy upstairs will transform him into a Dark Squirrel.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player does not have a Dark squirrel following them:

steps.player: Wow, I didn't know that! That sounds pretty cool.

steps.npc: Yeah, that's what I thought but that mysterious stranger is asking for 3,000 Hallowed marks for it.
Yeah, that's what I thought. Feels like he set the price just to keep me down here for longer. Still, it's not like I have anything better to do.

steps.player: I see, well best of luck. Hopefully you survive long enough to finish your goal.

standard-dialogue.text: If the player has a Dark squirrel following them:

steps.player: Yeah, I ended up buying one myself and fed it to my Giant Squirrel. It took a while but it was definitely worth it.

steps.npc: Wow, I'm impressed! How long did it take you to get the 3,000 marks?

steps.player: Long enough... Still, at least I feel much more agile now than when I started.

steps.npc: I don't think I'm going to get any more agile while looking for it myself. I'm glad you received some benefit from the grind though.

steps.player: I see, well best of luck. Hopefully you survive long enough to finish your goal.

standard-dialogue-using-a-dark-acorn-on-.text: You shouldn't feed someone's pet without their permission.

overhead-dialogue-when-attempting-to-ope.npc: Agh, thought I had it that time!
